# dash_apostrophe-lowercase-km4.2

## Automatically generated word list

The automatically generated word list was extracted from the untokenised Korpus Malti v4.2 corpus (not publicly available) using the regular expression `[-a-zċġħżàòìèù\']+`.
The strings were extracted after lowercasing the texts, duplicates are removed, and ordered in descending order of frequency.
The strings were taken from the entire corpus (excluding the non-public literature domain), which makes it biased towards the legal domain as that is the biggest subcorpus.
The automatically extracted word list with frequencies is found in [`auto_word_list.txt`](auto_word_list.txt) and was extracted using the Python script [`get_word_list.py`](get_word_list.py).

## [`dash_apostrophe-lowercase-km4.2-v1`](dash_apostrophe-lowercase-km4.2-v1.txt)

Following the automatically extracted word list, a manual filtering process was performed.
The manual filtering followed these lax rules:

* All words must be correctly spelled (with conservative judgement if unsure).
* All words must be written in Maltese phonetical form to exclude English words (e.g. Manwel but not Manuel).
* No company names..

The most frequent 10,000 strings that pass the manual filtering made the cut.
Manual filtering was performed by a native Maltese speaker.
